name: Skip Link
summary: The first focusable thing in the document and the shortest route past everything a keyboard user would otherwise Tab through — clipped rather than hidden, because being reachable is the only thing it does.
demoNote: No JavaScript on this page. Click inside a frame and press Shift+Tab to reach its link. Example 5 is broken on purpose — both of its failures are live, so you can Tab through them and watch.
